cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Upload new interface
with open('/workspace/project/chunk_interface.txt', 'r') as f:
    interface_code = f.read()
# Replace the original interface
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '1,7d' /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
# Prepend new interface
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/chunk_interface.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(interface_code)
sftp.close()
# Now combine
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /tmp/chunk_interface.txt /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts > /tmp/chunk_temp.ts && mv /tmp/chunk_temp.ts /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
print("Fixed")
client.close()
EOF
